purpose: Teach: 的中/村長/手抜き/投じ/成し遂げ/はかっ/事由/斡旋

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 予測が的中したら、社内発表しましょう
lines.en: If the prediction comes through, let's present it to the whole team.
lines.style: Calm, purposeful pace. Opens with quiet confidence. Forward momentum—not rushed, but decisive. Ends with a slight upswing, inviting agreement without demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方の村長との合同企画を準備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare the joint project with the local village head.
lines.style: Straightforward, attentive. Slight nod in the voice. Steady, reliable tone. No flourish—just competent follow-through. Small pause after the affirmation before moving to action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 現場の手抜きを防ぐチェック体制を整えましょう
lines.en: Let's set up a system to catch any cutting corners in the field work.
lines.style: Measured, clear instruction. Slight emphasis on 'system'—establishing structure. Matter-of-fact but not cold. The tone of someone who's seen mistakes happen before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告に予算を多く投じます
lines.en: Understood. I'll allocate more of the budget toward advertising.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Almost professional shorthand—we're past explanation. Small lift at 'budget,' showing he's ready to act on this decision.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 成し遂げた成果を月次報告にまとめましょう
lines.en: Let's compile what we've accomplished into the monthly report.
lines.style: Steady, summarizing tone. Slower pace—pulling things together. Reflective quality, like taking stock. Slight warmth, acknowledging effort before turning it into documentation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コストをはかった上で稟議に上げます
lines.en: Understood. I'll measure the costs and submit it through the proper channels.
lines.style: Efficient, procedural. The voice of someone moving through checklist items with quiet competence. Even rhythm, no hesitation. Ready to execute the next step.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 退職の事由を本人と確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's confirm the reason for the resignation directly with them.
lines.style: Tone shifts—more careful now. Quiet, measured pace. Gentle but serious. The care of handling something sensitive. Slight emphasis on 'directly,' showing respect for the person involved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取引斡旋業者との関係を整理します
lines.en: Understood. I'll clean up the relationships with our broker contacts.
lines.style: Calm closing note. Professional, matter-of-fact. Small sense of wrapping up loose ends. Steady, no urgency—this is methodical closure.
